Question ID: ENG4_U04_L02_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG4.RS.01

Research Question: How do evening library hours affect adult learners? Source A gives attendance data. Source B gives an interview with one learner. Source C gives staffing cost information. Which source combination is strongest for an initial synthesis?

answer.text: A. Source B alone because personal stories are always enough.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This answer does not fully match the lesson skill or it misreads the evidence, research focus, or source information in the item.

answer.text: B. Sources A, B, and C together because they show demand, human impact, and feasibility.

feedback.text: Correct. This answer applies the lesson skill accurately and matches the evidence, research focus, or source information in the item.

answer.text: C. Source C alone because cost is the only issue.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This answer does not fully match the lesson skill or it misreads the evidence, research focus, or source information in the item.

answer.text: D. None of the sources because they are not identical.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This answer does not fully match the lesson skill or it misreads the evidence, research focus, or source information in the item.
